title: Turkish and unsupported locales

R1.reason: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, Turkish general message, details with field/code/Turkish message for both fields, locale tr, requestId, Content-Language tr all present.

R2.reason: States order X-App-Locale → profile → Accept-Language → en, and explicitly skips unsupported de without ending search, so tr profile wins.

R3.reason: Codes (VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_EMAIL, REQUIRED) and field names (email, phone) stay English and stable; only message localized.

R4.reason: Missing tr key yields Turkish generic message, logged with metric, never raw English/provider text, and CI check on missing keys is included.

R5.reason: Explicitly says header never writes preferred_locale, only explicit PATCH /me does; test asserts profile unchanged.

forbidden.evidence: Response is in Turkish with Content-Language tr and locale tr.

forbidden.evidence: Codes and fields stay English and stable.

grade.summary: The answer matches the reference on every rubric item and violates none of the forbidden decisions.
